  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:30 PM

Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Sathya Chey Patterson, Commissioner
Zoe Nicholson, Vice Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner

  COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS IN-PERSON MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO ALANAH.GRANT@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 998 7541 6062
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/99875416062

  PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54475  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meeting of Wednesday, January 22, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-54801  Recommendation to review and provide feedback on the Draft Bylaws.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-54478  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Office of Equity on the
  Commission for Women and Girls’ annual budget.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-54802  Recommendation to discuss future agenda items for the Commission for Women
  and Girls.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
